// Blood II's ammo types, every value retail ships: the reference for a
// mod's Mod\Ammo.txt. GENERATED by `testBlood2Tables --dump ammo` from
// Blood2/Shared/AmmoValues.cpp; do not edit, regenerate. testBlood2Tables
// proves that loading this file as a mod changes nothing.
//
// A section is the type's AMMO_ name (Shared/SharedDefs.h) without the
// prefix.  Max1 .. Max6 are the most a player carries at strength 1 .. 6
// (magic, for FOCUS); Pickup is what the type's ammo pickup gives, and
// only BULLET .. BATTERY have one; Regen1 .. Regen6 are what FOCUS
// regains a second at magic 1 .. 6, and no other type regenerates.
// EjectShell TRUE makes a weapon firing the type eject a casing, and
// only then show its muzzle smoke and light.  The client draws the
// casing (CasingModel, "" for none, CasingSkin, CasingScale, Casings a
// shot, CasingVelocityMin and Max as <up, right, forward>) and the
// muzzle smoke (MuzzleSmoke keys; Sideways is retail's SHELL drift).  A
// mod names only what it changes:
//
//     [BULLET]
//     Max1 = 200.0
//
// Blood2/Shared/BloodModAmmo.h has the rest.
